note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Taiwan: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A resident's net taxable income for 2026 is taxed at 5% to TWD 610,000, 12% to 1,380,000, 20% to 2,770,000, 30% to 5,190,000 and 40% above, after a personal exemption of TWD 101,000, a standard deduction of 136,000 (single) and a salary special deduction of up to 227,000.
figures.applies: Tax year 2026 (filed May 2027); residents (183 days or more).

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the annual return is filed and any balance paid between 1 and 31 May of the following year.

sources.said: A taxpayer shall, within the period from May 1 to May 31 of each year, fill out and file to the competent tax authority an annual income tax return
The tax year is the same as the calendar year, which runs from 1 January through 31 December.

figures.finding: Labour insurance in 2026 is 12.5% of the insured monthly salary (11.5% ordinary risk plus 1% employment insurance), borne 20% by the worker, 70% by the employer and 10% by government; national health insurance and labour pension are on top (foreigners are outside the labour pension).
figures.applies: 2026; on the insured salary grade, which is capped.

sources.said: 勞保費率則為12.5％，其中普通事故保險費率為11.5％，就業保險費率則為1％。勞雇負擔比例則以勞工20％、雇主70％、政府10％計算

Taiwan social security programs include the Labour Insurance Program (LIP), National Health Insurance Program (NHIP), and Labour Pension Program (LPP). However, foreign individuals are not eligible for participating in the LPP.

figures.finding: Tax is withheld from locally paid salaries and the balance settled on the May return.

sources.said: There is income tax withholding on locally paid salaries. Additional tax due must be paid at the time of filing before 31 May of the following year.

figures.finding: A non-resident (under 183 days) is withheld 20% on remuneration for professional practice (a performer's, writer's or director's fee), 18% on salaries (6% where monthly pay is at most 1.5 times the minimum wage) and 20% on royalties, final.

sources.said: The withholding tax rate on salaries is 18%. In the case that the monthly salaries in full amount are equal to or lower than one and a half times of the monthly baseline salary as assessed by the Executive Yuan, the withholding tax rate is 6% from January 1st, 2009.
The withholding tax rate on royalties is 20%.
The withholding tax rate on the remuneration to a professional practice is 20%.

figures.finding: An individual's income from publishing articles, books, musical compositions and drama productions is exempt up to TWD 180,000 a year in total.

sources.said: Individual income derived from publishing articles, books, musical compositions, drama productions, drawing cartoons, and remuneration on an hourly basis for speeches. However, the total amount of such income for the whole year shall not exceed NT$ 180,000;

figures.finding: Business tax (VAT) is 5%; specified industries and small businesses pay gross business receipts tax at 2% to 5% instead.

sources.said: The standard VAT rate is 5%. Gross business receipts tax (GBRT) GBRT is applicable to specified industries (e.g. financial institutions, small businesses) at rates ranging from 2% to 5%.

figures.finding: For a resident, the payer withholds 10% of a professional practitioner's fee (an author's or performer's included) and of royalties, and from salaries either by the salary withholding table or a flat 5% of the month's pay, the employee choosing.
figures.applies: Residents, 2026; the salary table is the blocker.

sources.said: 一、薪資按下列二種方式擇一扣繳，由納稅義務人自行選定適用之 … （二）按全月給付總額扣取百分之五。 … 六、權利金按給付額扣取百分之十 … 八、執行業務者之報酬按給付額扣取百分之十

figures.finding: A professional practitioner's own professional services are not a sale of services under the business tax, and authors and performers are professional practitioners, so a writer's or performer's own fee bears no business tax (VAT).
figures.applies: Individuals working on their own account as authors or performers; a company or registered business supplying the same services is taxed.
